title: Pick Fill Color (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Pick Fill Color applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Pick Fill Color (BtnPickFillColor) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnPickFillColor deterministic Office leg (fill-target apply with target-scope assertions)

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the color picker's fill-target apply path (ApplyColorToSelection with ApplyTarget.Fill, the exact code path the eyedropper uses for fill targets) runs on the fixture 3x3 table with a 40x20 probe selected: the probe's fill becomes OLE red 255 while the non-commanded targets keep their pre-painted values (fill/line white 16777215, text color unchanged), its text content and geometry stay unchanged and the table remains untouched (3x3, 100/50 cells, 300x150 at 40/40, texts intact); the run writes no new %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log entry, reports execution with the applied color, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the color picker's fill-target apply path (ApplyColorToSelection with ApplyTarget.Fill, the exact code path the eyedropper uses for fill targets) runs on the fixture 3x3 table with a 40x20 probe selected: the probe's fill becomes OLE red 255 while the non-commanded targets keep their pre-painted values (fill/line white 16777215, text color unchanged), its text content and geometry stay unchanged and the table remains untouched (3x3, 100/50 cells, 300x150 at 40/40, texts intact); the run writes no new %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log entry, reports execution with the applied color, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
